properties.name: Meteo Q295 AP
properties.description: When was the last month with measurable precipitation (> 1 mm) in City of Zurich in 2019?

properties.name: Annotate Meteo Dataset Operator
properties.description: Annotate the meteo tables with provenance information

properties.name: Q295 SQL Query Operator
properties.description: When was the last month with measurable precipitation (> 1 mm) in City of Zurich in 2019?
properties.query:
WITH time_window_1 AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mtp.time) AS time_window_2,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mtp.time) AS time_window_3,
    SUM(mtp.tp) AS total_precipitation
  FROM meteo_tp AS mtp
  WHERE
    (
      ROUND(CAST(mtp.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1),
      ROUND(CAST(mtp.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)
    ) IN ((47.4, 8.5))
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mtp.time) = 2019
  GROUP BY
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mtp.time),
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mtp.time)
)
SELECT
  time_window_1.time_window_2 AS time_window_2,
  time_window_1.time_window_3 AS time_window_3,
  time_window_1.total_precipitation AS precipitation_m
FROM time_window_1
WHERE
  time_window_1.total_precipitation > 0.001
ORDER BY
  time_window_1.time_window_2 DESC
LIMIT 1
